text: My landlord has ignored repeated reports of severe black mould in our flat. My young child has developed breathing problems and the mould is continuing to spread.
My benefit payment was stopped because of an administrative error. I currently have almost no money for food or electricity and have been unable to get the issue corrected.
I have received an eviction notice and may lose my accommodation within the next few days. I believe the council has incorrectly assessed my housing application.
I have repeatedly tried to resolve an error in my NHS records that is delaying an important specialist referral. I have contacted the relevant service several times without success.
My child's school and local authority have repeatedly delayed agreed support for their additional educational needs. I have been trying to resolve this for several months.
A government department has retained an important identity document much longer than expected. I have an imminent deadline that requires the document and have been unable to obtain an update.
